combo_label: Things That Beep × Maps & Navigation × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Dashed line telling you which county you have just entered
Palm-sized dial whose arrow never forgets where north is
Living god who wore the double crown of two lands
Dashboard direction-giver that bongs, then coldly announces 'Recalculating'.
Map upside down, signal gone, no idea which way is north
Ibis-headed patron of scribes and reckoning
Falcon-headed son who avenged his slain father to win the throne
Translucent white stone cut into vessels and lamps
Direction of sunset, and of Ireland from Britain
The other half of a timepiece's heartbeat, always a second behind the tick
Hole in the wall that beeps in a panic until you remember to take your card.
A sailor's map, inked with depths, wrecks and shoals
Bland piped tinkling that fills hotel lobbies and telephone hold queues
